messages:
sophia: Draft ready for final quick-pass and ops handshake — copying the publish-orbit checklist into the thread. Link: https://docs.google.com/draft-launch (DO NOT PUBLISH) Target publish: Tue 9am PT. Need: claim checks, benchmark wording, webinar CTA copy, and HubSpot form mapping. @mike_marketing @kevin_ops @alyssa_design please review by EOD.

mike_marketing: On it. I'll sanity-check the benchmark numbers and the 'cost per token' callout. If we tighten the hero claim to 'up to 3x throughput' we should add the test conditions (seq len, batch).

alyssa_design: Saw the draft briefly — hero visual needs to be portrait crop and we should use the new brand-blue (token-eco) for the throughput bar. Also prefer full-bleed > no card. Will push assets to the shared Figma file.

kevin_ops: Quick ops note: inbound demos need the HubSpot form to include a hidden property so routing works. Please confirm form name and property names. Also we need a canary group for first 1k registrants.

henry_sales: Sales + SDRs want the webinar CTA to state 'Register for the launch demo — limited seats' and include the product elevator 1-liner. If we add the pricing blurb, tag me and I'll prep follow-up templates.

mike_marketing: Agree on adding the test conditions. Suggest a 2nd line under hero: "(results on Llama-Tiny w/ seq=512, batch=8)" so readers don't misinterpret.

natalie_legal: quick-pass complete. No legal flags on the current claims. One suggestion: remove 'guaranteed' from the SLA example — change to 'targeted'.

content-bot: Friendly reminder: publish checklist not yet signed off — fields missing: hero alt text, HubSpot form id, demo ops owner.

kevin_ops: HubSpot mapping (example) — pls include this in the doc:```hubspot_form: launch_demo_v2 hidden_fields: {"source":"launch_blog","demo_path":"orbit-2025"} owner: ops-demo@redwood.ai``` Once that's in, I can wire routing to the demo calendar and set the canary.

alyssa_design: Uploaded hero and three supporting images to Figma: link https://www.figma.com/file/launch-asset. I added alt text in the comments.

mike_marketing: Also added a short FAQ block for the benchmark methodology — keep it scannable. I'll inline a two-sentence explainer under the Benchmarks section.

kevin_ops: Ops checklist (high level): 1) Confirm HubSpot form id + hidden fields 2) Create canary segment + test email 3) Verify inbound routing webhook to /demo-scheduler 4) Add fallback calendar if demo capacity > 80%

henry_sales: For lead routing, please add these HubSpot properties to the mapping: `campaign_source`, `demo_interest_level` (low/med/high), `acct_tier` (self-serve/enterprise). That way SDRs can prioritize.

sophia: Great, summary and next steps: - Mike: finalize benchmark wording + add test conditions (by 3pm PT) - Alyssa: lock hero asset + alt text (by 4pm PT) - Natalie: noted legal tweak (done) - Kevin: prepare HubSpot form mapping + canary (by EOD) - Henry: provide follow-up templates (tomorrow AM) I'll update the doc with the ops snippet and then lock copy for publish-scheduling. If all signoffs in place I'll hand to release-ops to queue the Tuesday 9am publish and start the demo seat canary. :rocket:

sophia: Adding publish-orbit checklist to the doc now — copying the critical bit below so ops can act:```PUBLISH-ORBIT-CHECKLIST
- Copy locked (content + legal signoff)
- Hero assets uploaded + alt text
- HubSpot form id + hidden fields set
- Canary segment created (1k seats)
- Demo webhook connected to /demo-scheduler
- SDRe templates ready
- Tracking UTM params: utm_source=launch_blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=orbit_launch
```

mike_marketing: Approved from marketing. All benchmark notes in doc.

natalie_legal: Legal approved (updated wording ok).

kevin_ops: Ops signed off on the mapping and canary. Will schedule test run at 5pm PT.

henry_sales: I'll prep 3 follow-up email variants and drop them into the doc by 10am tomorrow.

sophia: Perfect. Locking copy and handing to release-ops. Thanks all — will follow up with the publish runbook and demo capacity report post-test. :white_check_mark:
